bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=deploy-gaybbs-1
echo '=== LIVE_DIAG ==='
docker inspect -f 'CONTAINER_STATE={{.State.Status}} IMAGE_ID={{.Image}}' "$name" || true
docker images --format 'IMAGE={{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}} ID={{.ID}}' | grep -E 'gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs|gaybbs' | head -12 || true
docker exec "$name" test -f /app/gaybbs.mjs && echo BUNDLE_EXISTS=YES || true
echo '=== PANELS ==='
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||'|'||COALESCE(message_id::text,'NONE')||'|'||state FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' ORDER BY chat_id;"
echo '=== USERBOT ==='
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
echo '=== END ==='
